name: coding-rules-guard
description: Risk-routed workflow with bounded v5 attempts, stable evidence bindings, compact handoffs, progress projections, and conservative verification reuse queries.

interface.shortDescription: V5 bounded workflow, stable verification, and compact handoffs.
interface.longDescription: Coding Rules Guard routes low-risk work through a short FAST path, escalates cross-layer or high-risk work to FULL, and requires the current session's main model to create and review every write Plan. V5 adds bounded attempts and replans, source-bound diagnosis, stable before/after verification bindings, repeat-policy sampling, compact handoff projections, and conservative same-attempt verification queries. It never pretends to provide host-level identity or execution interception.
interface.defaultPrompt: Choose FAST or FULL, load only the current coding-rules phase, and use the current session main model as session_main for both Plan and final review, recording its actual model and reasoning effort at each gate. Use v5 bounded attempt/replan budgets; load loop-policy only for failure, recovery, or replan; query registered checks before repeating them and require stable before/after/current input bindings. Do not fall back to fixed Sol/xhigh planning or review, claim host execution interception, or create reports unless the user explicitly requests them.
